title: What happened to the Roanoke 'Lost Colony'
summary: When John White returned in 1590 the settlement was abandoned, with 'CROATOAN' carved on the palisade. No conclusive evidence of the colonists' fate has been found.
why: An entire English colony disappeared, leaving one carved word.
question: What happened to the English colonists left on Roanoke Island in 1587?
evidence: Colony left in 1587; abandoned by 1590; 'CROATOAN' carving; a 2011 study found a hidden fort symbol on White's map at the head of Albemarle Sound.
wouldSettle: Securely dated colonist artefacts or remains at a specific later site.

theories.name: Joined Native communities
theories.idea: The colonists assimilated with nearby Native tribes, such as at Croatoan.

theories.name: Killed
theories.idea: Jamestown-era reports claimed the settlers had been massacred.
